journal.dayNoteHint: This note is shared across accounts. AI recaps use the selected filters and append a labeled section. Shared notes are excluded from filtered AI context.

voice.unsupported: This browser does not support speech recognition. Open the journal in Chrome, or use keyboard dictation below.
voice.keyboardHint: Keyboard dictation types directly into your note. Use your keyboard’s microphone key or your system’s dictation shortcut. On Mac, enable Dictation in System Settings → Keyboard.
voice.readyStatus: Note ready. Press your keyboard’s microphone key or dictation shortcut to speak.

trades.deleteConfirm: Delete {count} trades and their executions? This cannot be undone.

rating.saveFailed: Rating was not saved. Try again.

rules.title: Strategy rule review
rules.addRules: Add rules to this playbook to review adherence.
rules.assignPlaybook: Assign a playbook to check its rules for this trade.

marketData.title: Market data & replay
marketData.intro: Load candles for this trade to use replay. Enable the checkbox to also calculate and save monetary MAE/MFE estimates for Reports.
marketData.connectProvider: Connect a market data provider in Settings
marketData.connectSuffix: to use historical replay and estimates.
marketData.optionsUnsupported: Option contract history is not supported yet.
marketData.confirmEstimates: Calculate and save MAE/MFE estimates for Reports. I confirm that this instrument, price adjustments and quote currency match my fills and account ({currency}).
marketData.confirmHint: Unchecked: load candles and replay only. Checked: also calculate monetary estimates and save valid results to Reports. Missing or mismatched data stays unavailable.
marketData.savedHint: Previously saved MAE/MFE estimates are shown below. Loading candles without the checkbox keeps those saved estimates; it does not calculate new ones.
marketData.noCandles: No candles were returned for this instrument and trade period. Check the symbol, dataset and plan coverage.
marketData.privacyHidden: Historical prices and excursion amounts are hidden in privacy mode.
marketData.basisMismatch: The market candles and recorded fill prices do not match. Replay shows market prices; fill labels and MAE/MFE estimates are withheld. See the data limits below.
marketData.candlesThrough: {count} / {total} candles · Through {through} (UTC). Candles are revealed at bar close; this is not a tick-by-tick simulation.
marketData.chartUpdateFailed: The replay chart could not be updated.
marketData.chartRenderFailed: The historical chart could not be rendered.

chart.privacyCaption: Recorded fills as a percentage of average entry. Privacy mode keeps prices and monetary P&L hidden.
chart.fillsCaption: Price path from recorded fills. To view market candles, choose a data source and load history in Market data & replay.
